reason: Everything already runs on WhatsApp on my one phone, and my stylists are busy with clients and won't stop to take selfies and type numbers for every walk-in. The cash-drawer check is tempting with two outlets, but I'm not paying ₹4,999 upfront to find out my staff ignore it after a week.
objection: My staff won't keep typing everything in during a rush, so the reports will be half-empty and I'll be back to checking the register and WhatsApp anyway. And it's only in English.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it actually running in another salon owner's outlet that I know, with staff using it daily, and the setup fee waived or charged only after the free month if we keep it.
